items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: A drummer named Mike Barsimanto, lives in L.A., and Mike Formanek. These were 18-year-olds. I called it the 3M quartet.

ctx.x: A drummer named Mike Barsimanto, lives in L.A., and Mike Formanek. These were 18-year-olds. I called it the 3M quartet. We worked. We played lofts. We played in the San Francisco area, same time as I was with Eddie Henderson. But I liked Formanek. He was talented, and he wanted to get out of there. So this is a bandleader thing. Take a new guy. He stayed – I found a loft very quickly when I came back, and he stayed with me and so forth. He was going to be the bass player, and I wanted Moses, because that’s – I…
